quotes.name: Dominic Okeke-Brandt
quotes.quote: I've seen Lena Marchetti's name come up a few times in conversations around town. To be honest, I don't know much about them, but they seem to be someone people are talking about. I've heard they're from East Oakland, but that's about it.

quotes.name: Kai Davis
quotes.quote: I've seen Lena Marchetti's name around, but I don't know much about them personally. I did hear they moved into a place of their own in East Oakland. That's all I know.

quotes.name: Evan Lewis
quotes.quote: To be honest, I've not heard much about Lena Marchetti around here. The A's trade news is what's been on my mind lately, and how it's affecting the community. I've seen some of the players around Laurel, like Arturo Ramos and John Ellis, they're nice guys. But I haven't really connected the name Lena Marchetti to anything specific in our neighborhood or the A's. I've noticed people keeping to themselves more, and that's been on my mind.
